concerns.text: FR-006–FR-018 introduce a full scaling‑factor fitting and residual‑diagnostics pipeline. The original idea only asks whether DFT‑D3 predicts ion‑pair interaction energies accurately; a post‑hoc scaling correction is not required to answer that research question, so this adds work beyond the stated scope.

FR-008–FR-011 (and US‑3) add an exploratory correlation between D3 terms (raw or scaled) and bulk properties (density, viscosity). The idea does not request any bulk‑property analysis, thus the spec redefines the research question to include a separate hypothesis, constituting scope drift/over‑reach.
